current_local_metadata_only.directory_role: current user's Downloads; absolute private path omitted

browser_observation.future_browser_inventory_rule: Do not emit full browser-tab URLs; inspect only sanitized host, product identity, and tab count. Never replay a signed URL.
browser_observation.inference: The two exact-name files are consistent with the one EarthExplorer action and the two subsequent signed-link tabs, but no browser event bound either file to a completed download; file provenance is not yet verified.

official_source_context.interpretation: USGS describes EarthExplorer-managed Collection 2 downloads and says the landsatlook background service remains operational. This supports the host relationship, not the identity or integrity of either local file.

eight_criterion_assessment_for_proposed_.identity: Exact product IDs and scene IDs remain frozen; local filenames alone are insufficient and both MTL forms must later match.
eight_criterion_assessment_for_proposed_.authority: USGS remains the publisher for the selected Collection 2 Level-2 products; the local files have not yet been authenticated as its bytes.
eight_criterion_assessment_for_proposed_.access: Two before files are visible by filesystem metadata; no new before request is proposed. After access requires one future owner-initiated browser action under fresh signed-in preflight.
eight_criterion_assessment_for_proposed_.rights: The prior USGS no-restrictions source check applies to Landsat source products; verify current terms and account conditions before any new request. This does not release derived-pixel publication.
eight_criterion_assessment_for_proposed_.provenance: The lost browser event/path is a material provenance gap. A conditional local-file adoption method needs explicit owner acceptance, strict filename and time-window binding, duplicate-byte agreement, and unchanged exact source identity.
eight_criterion_assessment_for_proposed_.integrity: No local source bytes have been read. Require complete local SHA-256 measurements of both before files, exact equality, safe TAR structure, complete member stream checks, both MTL identity forms, verified staging, and no-replace promotion.
eight_criterion_assessment_for_proposed_.fitness: The proposed result is container custody for subsequent QA only; archive checks cannot establish AOI pixel usability or a map.
eight_criterion_assessment_for_proposed_.privacy_security: The prior tab inventory exposed ephemeral signed links in private tool output, not Git. Do not repeat this: emit only sanitized host/count, never record or replay signed URLs, cookies, account identifiers, local private paths, browser tokens, or payload bytes; reject reparse points and unsafe paths and retain all original downloads.
